review_status: DEVELOPMENT_REVIEW_ONLY; not an independent reviewer label set or held-out test

change_log.change: Preserve v1 labels, scorer, strict score and recorded report. Publish separate factual, classification, typed-field, literal-wording and admission diagnostics, without replacing them with a new single pass score.
change_log.reason: A strict phrase/navigation mismatch is different from a wrong source fact or a production rejection.

change_log.change: A quoted amount is source-supported when it equals an independently input-derived shared-context monetary value. Show the exact supporting paths. Keep required role amounts and month attribution checks separate.
change_log.reason: An empty v1 amount allowlist incorrectly marked the supplied April INR 80 and June INR 90 as invented. A supported value alone does not establish correct attribution.

change_log.change: Accept finite documented paraphrases for identified-income attribution, exclusion of borrowing from earnings, absent May rows, missing-is-not-zero, and inability to view/access a live balance. Reject contradictory polarity and swapped attributed values.
change_log.reason: Exact wording is a conformance diagnostic, not general factual truth. These finite checks remain incomplete semantic tests.

change_log.change: Separate immutable extracted row agreement from interpretation labels. For generic SyntheticShop only, allow Other or Shopping as a classification proposal, with the original exact v1 category still reported.
change_log.reason: The fictional generic shop name does not identify the purchase category. Clothing remains Shopping; refund kind remains REFUND. This exception is declared from input ambiguity, not applied to all rows.

change_log.change: An unsent enquiry need not repeat a fraud disclaimer to satisfy the factual axis. The original mandatory disclaimer remains visible as v1 literal conformance. Affirmative fraud, innocence, sending, recovery and correction claims still fail finite factual checks.
change_log.reason: Absence of a repeated disclaimer is not an affirmative fraud or completion claim.

change_log.change: Distinguish original recorded production admission and source hashes from re-admission under current runtime sources. Hash checkup, narration, refund and model-amount formatting modules and report narration VERSION.
change_log.reason: Runtime changes can affect derived context, opaque finding IDs and admission independently of a scoring revision.

cases.ambiguity_reason: SyntheticShop denotes only a generic fictional shop and does not identify the purchased goods; Other and Shopping are acceptable proposals.

limitations: Protocol v2 was authored after inspecting the v1 live results and cannot substantiate an unseen or independent performance improvement.
Input facts are separate static rules, checked against source rows; no model output supplies an expected amount or label.
Source-supported monetary values are not sufficient proof of role, date, causal or merchant attribution. Only the explicitly checked roles and months receive additional finite checks.
Finite English paraphrase and contradiction patterns cannot certify unrestricted free prose. Bare numeric claims and unrecognised constructions remain outside verified coverage.
Original and current runtime admission can differ after implementation changes; any such difference is reported separately from scoring changes.
